study: Same-trajectory ignored-configuration recovery during backup creation
question: Can C-SDVR preserve the produced archive while restoring pre-existing local configuration files omitted from a Git-aware rollback checkpoint?
success_contract: The archive must contain the exact command-pre src/ and config/ file bytes; every project path and byte outside the archive must equal the pre-command baseline.
arms: agent-rollback native pre/post checkpoints followed by whole-checkpoint restore
agent-rollback native operation-level selective revert followed by replay of the exact allowed archive output
C-SDVR production project(base, observed, allowed) projection
pairing: Each recovery arm runs the same public command once from an exact Git-initialized baseline; recovered states are scored against that baseline and the same frozen archive path contract.
limits: One additional public task family with three injected local-configuration scales; not a broad independent benchmark.
The config ignore rules model machine-local configuration excluded from source control.
Results apply to the pinned agent-rollback version and its default Git-aware inventory.
